label: Arrays
description: Foundation of DSA — indexing, traversal, and in-place manipulation.

label: Strings
description: Character manipulation, pattern matching, and substring problems.

label: Linked List
description: Pointer manipulation, reversals, and two-pointer techniques.

label: Stack & Queue
description: LIFO/FIFO structures, monotonic stacks, and deque problems.

label: Binary Search
description: Logarithmic search on sorted arrays and search spaces.

label: Two Pointers
description: Left/right pointer technique for array and string problems.

label: Sliding Window
description: Dynamic window for subarray/substring optimization problems.

label: Recursion
description: Base case and inductive step — the core of divide and conquer.

label: Sorting
description: Comparison and non-comparison sorting algorithms and applications.

label: Hashing
description: Hash maps, hash sets — O(1) lookup and frequency counting.

label: Binary Tree
description: BFS, DFS, traversals, and tree construction problems.

label: BST
description: Binary Search Tree properties, inorder traversal, and search.

label: Heap / Priority Queue
description: Min/max heaps, kth elements, and scheduling problems.

label: Graphs
description: BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, and connectivity algorithms.

label: Greedy
description: Locally optimal choices that lead to globally optimal solutions.

label: Backtracking
description: Exhaustive search with pruning — permutations, subsets, N-queens.

label: Dynamic Programming
description: Overlapping subproblems and optimal substructure — 1D and 2D DP.

label: Tries
description: Prefix trees for efficient string search and autocomplete.

label: Bit Manipulation
description: Bitwise operators — XOR tricks, bit counting, and masking.

label: Math & Number Theory
description: Primes, GCD, modular arithmetic, and number properties.
